$schema_note: WF11 runtime channel capability table for Skill 35 Community publishing. This is the table scripts/community_publish.py READS at runtime (not a prose platform list). Two rules bind it: (1) a selected platform's own limits govern that platform's request, so a Community caption is never silently truncated by a shorter channel sharing the cycle; (2) `community` is a first-class destination with its own limits and its own nested author mapping, so an external social marketing post is never broadcast into a private group without an approved inside-group task. Limits transcribed from the revision-3.0 implementation contract section 11.3/11.5; checked_at records when the profile was last reconciled.

policy.split_rule: One provider request per platform. Never merge a Community destination with an external destination into one request.
policy.unmapped_platform_policy: A platform with no row here is REFUSED by name. It is never posted with borrowed limits.
policy.community_broadcast_default: notifyAllGroupMembers defaults to false and is only enabled with an explicit approval record.

community.attachment_note: Community comment attachment URLs are not rendered because of the Community bucket restriction. A successful comment response is never described as a successfully attached resource.
